dimension_basis: 2.0 m overall: a life-size figure (about 1.75 m) on a plinth of about 0.25 m, chosen for this import as a real-world size. The Ginkgo scene and Project Y2K v061 placed it at 2.4 m. Scaled uniformly to that height; width and depth measured after scaling. Not a physical survey.
reference_review: Reference image reviewed on 2026-11-20 at full resolution (1024 px): no inscription, lettering, logos or marks. A generic classical togate figure with a scroll, in the manner of Greco-Roman portrait statues (a public-domain genre); not identified as a copy of a specific known sculpture, and the idealised face is not a recognisable likeness of a real person. A sculpture, not a character.
